@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Samantha didn't do so well in the r______l, but in the actual performance, she impressed the whole audience.
= rehearsal
~詞義 rehearsal（n.）排演
~原文 Samantha didn't do so well in the rehearsal, but in the actual performance, she impressed the whole audience.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Tracy dropped the box several times, but surprisingly, the cookies in it remained i______t.
= intact
~詞義 intact（adj.）未受損傷的
~原文 Tracy dropped the box several times, but surprisingly, the cookies in it remained intact.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: A 500-milliliter serving of bubble tea may contain up to 320 calories, the e______t of 20 sugar cubes.
= equivalent
~詞義 equivalent（n.）等同的
~原文 A 500-milliliter serving of bubble tea may contain up to 320 calories, the equivalent of 20 sugar cubes.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: During the summer training, Ken made s______l progress and reached the goals he had set earlier in the year.
= substantial
~詞義 substantial（adj.）可觀的
~原文 During the summer training, Ken made substantial progress and reached the goals he had set earlier in the year.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The carpenter r______ed the wooden chair with metal bars; it is now a very sturdy chair.
= reinforced
~詞義 reinforce（v.）加固
~原文 The carpenter reinforced the wooden chair with metal bars; it is now a very sturdy chair.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The star player is the highest paid athlete in the baseball ______, and his performances prove that he is worth the price.
A: dough
B: league
C: orchard
D: stack
= B
~詞義 league（n.）聯盟
~原文 The star player is the highest paid athlete in the baseball league, and his performances prove that he is worth the price.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Studies show that regular exercise ______ strongly with improved mental health.
A: injects
B: correlates
C: corrupts
D: transits
= B
~詞義 correlate（v.）關聯;相關
~原文 Studies show that regular exercise correlates strongly with improved mental health.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The black coffee was so bitter that I had to add several ______ of sugar in order to sweeten it.
A: attics
B: lumps
C: stews
D: suites
= B
~詞義 lump（n.）塊
~原文 The black coffee was so bitter that I had to add several lumps of sugar in order to sweeten it.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The Constitution is the ______ law of this country. No other law can violate its principles.
A: graphic
B: optional
C: suburban
D: supreme
= D
~詞義 supreme（adj.）最高的
~原文 The Constitution is the supreme law of this country. No other law can violate its principles.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Liam's friends admired him because, even during setbacks, he remained a(n) ______ who encouraged others to keep trying.
A: recipient
B: outsider
C: successor
D: optimist
= D
~詞義 optimist（n.）樂觀主義者
~原文 Liam's friends admired him because, even during setbacks, he remained a(n) optimist who encouraged others to keep trying.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: bulk
B: injected
C: corridor
D: repaid
E: rental
F: trims

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: My grandfather is into gardening. Every morning, he ______ the bushes around our yard and waters the plants.
= F
~詞義 trim（v.）修剪
~原文 My grandfather is into gardening. Every morning, he trims the bushes around our yard and waters the plants.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: The coffee shop buys tissue paper in ______ to help lower its expenses.
= A
~詞義 bulk（n.）大批
~原文 The coffee shop buys tissue paper in bulk to help lower its expenses.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Ben thinks he doesn't need to own a car. He can just go to places by public transportation, and if he needs a car, he can just get a(n) ______ one.
= E
~詞義 rental（adj.）出租
~原文 Ben thinks he doesn't need to own a car. He can just go to places by public transportation, and if he needs a car, he can just get a(n) rental one.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: Tina has lent her boyfriend a lot of money, but he hasn't ______ her yet.
= D
~詞義 repay（v.）償還
~原文 Tina has lent her boyfriend a lot of money, but he hasn't repaid her yet.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: The brand hired a new designer, who ______ a sense of fun and modernity into its products.
= B
~詞義 inject（v.）投入
~原文 The brand hired a new designer, who injected a sense of fun and modernity into its products.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: supposedly
B: driveway
C: gravity
D: outsider
E: rendered
F: tripled

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: Dad's car is not parked on the ______, and that means he is not home at the moment.
= B
~詞義 driveway（n.）私人車道
~原文 Dad's car is not parked on the driveway, and that means he is not home at the moment.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: All the students have ______ turned in their reports, but the professor hasn't checked them yet.
= A
~詞義 supposedly（adv.）大概
~原文 All the students have supposedly turned in their reports, but the professor hasn't checked them yet.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: Sales have ______ since the new manager joined the office. He is indeed a great leader for the company.
= F
~詞義 triple（v.）增至三倍
~原文 Sales have tripled since the new manager joined the office. He is indeed a great leader for the company.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: There is no ______ in outer space, which creates difficulties for astronauts. For example, they have to tie themselves down when they sleep.
= C
~詞義 gravity（n.）重力
~原文 There is no gravity in outer space, which creates difficulties for astronauts. For example, they have to tie themselves down when they sleep.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: The volunteers ______ valuable service to the community by distributing food and supplies during the storm.
= E
~詞義 render（v.）提供
~原文 The volunteers rendered valuable service to the community by distributing food and supplies during the storm.
